qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Swiss consumer finance and co-branded credit card platform. Completely lacks pricing power due to statutory interest rate caps under the Swiss Consumer Credit Act (KKG, capped at 10% on cash loans and 12% on cards) and high partner-concentration risk (demonstrated by the loss of the anchor Migros Cumulus card contract).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Statutory price caps and lack of pricing power, REJECT). Swiss consumer lender constrained by Swiss Consumer Credit Act (KKG) interest rate caps (10-12% ceilings) and partner bargaining power (demonstrated by the loss of the Migros Cumulus credit card contract). Commodity credit risk without defensible moat.
qualitative.evidence: Statutory interest rate ceilings under Swiss KKG eliminate pricing power during inflation. High partner-concentration vulnerability evidenced by Migros terminating its flagship Cumulus card partnership. Mediocre capital returns (ROE 12-13% on a levered banking balance sheet) fail the moat test.
